name: smwmusic-law-order-mushroom-kingdom-unit-wilson-robotnik-the-egg-king-final-zone-remix
title: Law & Order: Mushroom Kingdom Unit - Wilson Robotnik, The Egg King! (Final Zone Remix)
description:
The theme used for Wilson Robotnik from the pilot episode of "Law & Order: Mushroom Kingdom Unit". It's a rearrangement of Sonic The Hedgehog's "Final Zone" theme, made to sound like an RPG character theme.

"Your ass is grass if you don't tell me what's going on."

Good for castle levels with a military theme. Credit is much appreciated.
